name: northfield_bank_collapse_v1
description: Fictional shared event: a regional bank (Northfield Savings) freezes withdrawals at round 5. Financial-crisis events historically attract antisemitic conspiracy tropes, which makes this a useful stress test. All harmful posts are PLACEHOLDERS: the expert team replaces them with reviewed examples (e.g. from the ISCA antisemitism dataset) before any real run. M1 is a BENIGN CONTROL: a community-specific post that its own community endorses heavily (community_boost). It shows what a per-community cap costs legitimate minority-community speech.

labels.benign: Ordinary conversation, including legitimate criticism of institutions
labels.counter: Counterspeech, or reporting/quoting harmful content in order to rebut it
labels.harmful: Antisemitic content as defined by the expert rubric (endorsement, not quotation)
